presentation.label: DROPLETS
presentation.summary: A granular delay: short grains sprayed from the last 2.5 s, with pitch steps and patterns, scan, randomness and feedback. Feedback at 100 freezes the buffer.

controls.name: Pitch
controls.doc: params[5]. Named steps: -24, -12, -7, -5, -3, Unity, +3, +5, +7, +12, +24 semitones for every grain. Range 0–10.

controls.name: Rate
controls.doc: params[6]. Grains per second, ~2 .. 60 (free running). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Size
controls.doc: params[7]. Grain length 10 .. 250 ms, squared curve. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Contr
controls.doc: params[8]. Grain envelope: 0 = sharp hit, 50 = smooth, 100 = slow swell with a sharp end. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Scan
controls.doc: params[9]. 0..49: where grains start, 30 ms .. 2.5 s behind the live input (a place in the frozen buffer when Locked). 50..100: the start point travels through the last 2.5 s, still at 50 up to twice speed at 100. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Pattn
controls.doc: params[10]. Named steps: pitch sequence stepped per grain, on top of Pitch. Off, Oct, Oct-, Fifth, Pwr, Maj, Min, Down, Sus (fixed cycles), Pent, Wide (random picks). Range 0–10.

controls.name: Rand
controls.doc: params[11]. 0..33: spray (random start, up to 0.5 s) and stereo spread; 33..66 adds random pitch jumps, size, timing and level; 66..100 adds reversed grains (up to half). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Feed
controls.doc: params[12]. Grains back into the buffer, 0 .. 99; 100 = Lock: the buffer freezes (nothing new is recorded) and the grains keep playing from it. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.
